global_notes: Three systemic problems across the motion family: (1) RAW BEZIERS — composition-motion-overview.html, motion-beat.html, EmotiTone v2 file, and composition-drawer.html all hardcode cubic-bezier(...) values that should reference --ease-swing/-stab/-brush/-sustain/-bend (this is explicitly forbidden by the brand brief). (2) NAME COLLISIONS — 'rip' is used for the corner-paper-rip in played-flash AND for the knob-label mode-rip in state-cascade; 'pulse' / 'b' / 'knobBeat' / 'pulseTape' / 'beat' all describe the same beat breath; 'lift' / 'tileFire' / 'tile-bob' overlap. (3) SHADOWED CANONICALS — _card.css redefines brass-sheen with different timing than colors_and_type.css, and since every specimen loads _card.css the canonical is effectively dead. Phase 3 fold: promote downbeat-strobe / tile-bob / played-flash (lift+ring+rip composite) / mode-rip / tab-slide / drawer-rise into @keyframes + utility classes in colors_and_type.css; delete the _card.css brass-sheen duplicate; remove the composition-motion-overview.html keyframe re-definitions and have it consume the primitive utilities; strip all raw cubic-bezier(...) values and replace with --ease-* tokens; collapse the EmotiTone Design System v2.html legacy file out of the inventory (it's the source the motion-overview was copied from).
